name: AMBROXOL / CLENBUTEROL SOLUTION BROXOL PLUS 120 ML 1 PIECE
description: It is used as a bronchodilator and mucolytic to treat respiratory illnesses accompanied by bronchospasm and secretion retention. If discomfort persists, consult your doctor.
